definitions.explanation: The craft of making Western-style clothing (dresses, shirts, pants, etc.) using patterns and a sewing machine. Distinguished from traditional Japanese sewing ({和裁|わさい}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋裁|ようさい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{得意|とくい}→得意：03455_tokui⟧だ。
examples.english: My mother is good at dressmaking.

examples.japanese: {洋裁|ようさい}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若|わか}い{頃|ころ}、{洋裁|ようさい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生計|せいけい}→生計：13524_seikei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てていた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother made her living through dressmaking when she was young.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ (Western) + {裁|さい} (sewing, cutting fabric). Refers specifically to the construction of Western-style garments, as opposed to ⟦{和裁|わさい}→和裁：20825_wasai⟧ (Japanese-style sewing for kimono and other traditional garments).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洋裁|ようさい}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧: dressmaking class
- {洋裁|ようさい}⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧: dressmaking school
- {洋裁|ようさい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do dressmaking
- {洋裁|ようさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{型紙|かたがみ}→型紙：07349_katagami⟧: dressmaking pattern

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{和裁|わさい}→和裁：20825_wasai⟧: Japanese-style sewing — uses hand stitching and straight seams for kimono construction
- {洋裁|ようさい}: Western-style sewing — uses a sewing machine, curved patterns, and darts for fitted garments

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{裁縫|さいほう}→裁縫：04163_saihou⟧: sewing (general term, encompasses both Japanese and Western styles)
- ⟦ミシン→ミシン：06365_mishin⟧: sewing machine (from English "machine")
- ⟦{仕立|した}て→仕立てる：09525_shitateru⟧: tailoring
- ⟦{手芸|しゅげい}→手芸：07062_shugei⟧: handicrafts, needlework
